name: Rand Paul
committees: Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs (chair)
stance: Opposes broad AI mandates before Congress understands the technology; offered a bipartisan study committee on superintelligent AI instead of a kill-switch requirement.

statements.text: Objected to unanimous consent for Sen. Kennedy's AI Emergency Button Act and proposed instead a bipartisan committee to study the threat posed by superintelligent AI.
Are they going to have to redesign all search engines immediately if this passes and put kill switches in your search engine?
